Sandbox_JeevesClaims_MaxSafehouseClaims_: Maximum number of safehouses a single player can own. (1-5)
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_MaxVehicleClaims_to: Maximum number of vehicles a single player can claim. (1-10)
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_SafehouseExpiration: Safehouses are automatically released after this many real days of owner inactivity. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_VehicleExpirationDa: Claimed vehicles are automatically released after this many real days without owner interaction. Set to 0 to disable.
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_MaxClaimPadding_too: Maximum padding tiles a player can choose when claiming a safehouse. Players select their padding in 2-tile increments up to this value. (2-16)
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_ProtectSpawnRadius_: Prevents claiming buildings within this many tiles of a player spawn point. Set to 0 to disable spawn protection. (0-200)
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_ResidentialRequireL: Building must contain a living room to be considered residential. Only applies when SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false.
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_ResidentialRequireK: Building must contain a kitchen to be considered residential. Only applies when SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false.
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_ResidentialRequireB: Building must contain a bedroom to be considered residential. Only applies when SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false.
Building must contain a bathroom to be considered residential. Only applies when SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false.
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_ResidentialMatchMod: 1 = Must contain ALL checked room types. 2 = Must contain AT LEAST ONE checked room type.
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_GarageProximityEnab: When enabled, small garage and shed buildings (1-2 rooms) can be claimed if a residential building is nearby. Only applies when SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false.
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_GarageProximity_too: When SafehouseAllowNonResidential is false, small buildings (like garages) that fail the room type check can still be claimed if a residential building is within this many tiles. Set to 0 to disable. (0-30)
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_CustomClaimEnabled_: Allow players to claim a predefined grid area for custom-built structures that PZ doesn't recognize as buildings. Claims cannot overlap existing buildings, roads, or other claims.
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_CustomClaimSizes_to: Available grid sizes for custom land claims, comma-separated. (e.g. 10,20,30,40)
Sandbox_JeevesClaims_SafehouseKeysEnable: When enabled, claiming a building locks all doors and gives the player 2 safehouse keys. Players can lock/unlock doors from either side via context menu.
